name: Jephthah
summary: A mighty man of valour from Gilead, driven out by his brothers and later called back to lead his people against Ammon. A vow he made before the battle fell on his only child, his daughter.

key_moments.title: Driven Out by His Brothers
key_moments.description: Jephthah's brothers drove him out because his mother was a harlot. He went to live in the land of Tob, and worthless men gathered to him.

key_moments.title: Called Home to Lead Gilead
key_moments.description: When Ammon made war on Israel, the elders of Gilead came for Jephthah. He agreed to lead them if the LORD gave him victory, and they made him their head.

key_moments.title: Makes a Vow Before the Battle
key_moments.description: The Spirit of the LORD came on Jephthah, and he vowed to offer to the LORD whatever first came out of his house to meet him. The LORD gave the children of Ammon into his hands.

key_moments.title: His Daughter Comes to Meet Him
key_moments.description: His only child, his daughter, came out dancing with timbrels to meet him, and he tore his clothes. She asked for two months to mourn with her friends, then he did to her as he had vowed.

key_moments.title: Defeats Ephraim at the Jordan Fords
key_moments.description: When the men of Ephraim came against him, Jephthah fought them. The men of Gilead held the fords of the Jordan, and anyone who said Sibboleth instead of Shibboleth was killed.
